newsitem.title: USA: Clinton considering involvement in AMR dispute - Frost.
newsitem.headline: Clinton considering involvement in AMR dispute - Frost.

text.p: President Clinton is "seriously considering" becoming involved in the American Airlines labor dispute with its pilots, Rep. Martin Frost, D-Texas, said Thursday.

"It is something that the president is seriously considering," Frost said. Frost said he had spoken to administration representatives at the "high level" who have told him that Clinton is monitoring the dispute carefully.
Frost and Texas Republican Kay Granger introduced a resolution in the House of Representatives on Thursday to urge the president to take action.
"We urge the president to use his power in helping to resolve the American Airlines (threatened) strike," said Granger, a former mayor of Fort Worth, Texas, where American is based.

Frost and Granger are asking the president to urge the union and the airline to agree to binding arbitration. If the parties will not agree to arbitration, they want the president to convene an emergency board which would give more time to try to resolve the dispute.
The Allied Pilots Association and American Airlines are negotiating the pilots' contract in an effort to avert a looming strike set for Friday at midnight.
